paper.note: Downloader resolves the newest STABLE build for this pinned game version at run time and independently verifies the API-provided SHA-256.

required_plugins.name: LuckPerms
required_plugins.compatibility: Official download is for Bukkit/Paper and supports 1.8.8+.

required_plugins.name: WorldEdit
required_plugins.compatibility: Stable Paper release covers 26.2; required by WorldGuard.

required_plugins.name: WorldGuard
required_plugins.compatibility: Official 7.0.19 build declares 26.2-26.3 support; install with WorldEdit.

required_plugins.name: CoreProtect Community Edition
required_plugins.compatibility: Public stable Community Edition supports 1.16.5-26.2; this is the compatibility ceiling that keeps the set on 26.2 rather than 26.3.

required_plugins.name: VaultUnlocked
required_plugins.compatibility: Maintained Vault-compatible API replacement; release declares support through 26.3, including 26.2.

required_plugins.name: spark
required_plugins.compatibility: Paper 1.21+ bundles spark; do not install a duplicate by default.

not_installed_and_why.name: ClaimChunk 0.0.25-FIX3
not_installed_and_why.reason: Legacy pack's last listed build has documented testing only through Minecraft 1.20.6/1.21, with no declared 26.2 support. The current FunCity direction is an open city without player land claims; do not load this unverified plugin. Revisit only if claims become a confirmed requirement and a 26.2-compatible replacement is approved.

not_installed_and_why.name: ProtocolLib
not_installed_and_why.reason: No retained plugin in this lean stack needs packet interception. The stable ProtocolLib release does not declare 26.2; although upstream dev builds track 26.2, no development build is included without a required consumer.

not_installed_and_why.name: SkinsRestorer
not_installed_and_why.reason: Not required for an online-mode server, which remains the safe default. Add only if custom skin handling is explicitly required and its exact build is checked against 26.2.

not_installed_and_why.name: EssentialsXAntiBuild / EssentialsXProtect
not_installed_and_why.reason: Omitted as redundant with WorldGuard for the planned region-protection use; do not load duplicate build/protection layers without a specific tested need.
